capabilities.description: Record a patient visit with patient name, tooth, procedure performed and fee, storing each entry against the patient for a searchable, date-ordered visit history per patient. Clinician-owned for accuracy of treatment records.
Front-desk booking of patient appointments with date, time, patient, provider and chair/room, including rescheduling and cancellation. Receptionist-owned; drives both the daily list and reminders.
A simple front-desk dashboard showing today's appointments in time order with patient, provider, procedure and status, refreshed as bookings change.

Automatically send an email reminder to each patient the day before their scheduled appointment, using the clinic's email notification channel. Includes a log of sent reminders and handling of cancellations so no reminder goes out for a cancelled slot.
A simple patient register with demographics and contact details (including email for reminders) that links to visit history and appointments.
Search and filter a patient's visit history by date, tooth, procedure or provider so clinicians can review prior treatment quickly at the chair.

Role permissions for dentists, hygienist and receptionist: front desk owns scheduling and appointments, clinicians own clinical visit and treatment records. Keeps the four-person practice running with minimal admin.

summary: A lightweight practice management platform for a four-person dental clinic, enabling dentists, hygienists and receptionists to record patient visits with tooth-level procedure and fee detail, view and manage today's appointment schedule, and send automatic day-before email reminders. It provides searchable per-patient visit history while keeping scheduling owned by the front desk and clinical records owned by clinicians, with no document uploads or external system integrations beyond email notif
